records.jp: 愛央。お話したい……
records.en_original: Ao. I would like to talk with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. I would like to talk with you.
records.en: Ao. Kirara wants to talk...

records.jp: うん、私も！　今日はどこに行く？
records.en_original: Me too! Where are we going today?
records.en_auxiliary: Me too! Where are we going today?
records.en: Yeah, me too! Where are we going today?

records.jp: ん～……適当にぶらぶらする
records.en_original: Hmm... I think we should just wander.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I think we should just wander.
records.en: Hmm... We will wander around without a destination.

records.jp: オッケー！　じゃ、どーぞ
records.en_original: Okay! Here!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! Here!
records.en: Okay! Then here you go.

records.jp: これで、きららが転んでも大丈夫だね
records.en_original: Now I can help you if you fall.
records.en_auxiliary: Now I can help you if you fall.
records.en: Now you'll be okay even if you fall, Kirara.

records.jp: うむ。<CR>転ぶときは、愛央も道連れだけどな
records.en_original: Yes. Though if I do, you're coming down with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Though if I do, you're coming down with me.
records.en: Indeed.<CR>Though when Kirara falls, Ao will be dragged down too.

records.jp: この前さ。きららのまま、この世界に立っていたい<CR>って言ってたけど、あれからどう？
records.en_original: You mentioned last time you want to stand on your own in this world. How has that been going?
records.en_auxiliary: You mentioned last time you want to stand on your own in this world. How has that been going?
records.en: The other day you said you wanted to stand in this world as Kirara.<CR>How has it been since then?

records.jp: 今まで、声のおかげでできていた<CR>みんなのフォローができない
records.en_original: Until now, I was relying on the Divine to converse with everyone. But now...
records.en_auxiliary: Until now, I was relying on the Divine to converse with everyone. But now...
records.en: Kirara can no longer support everyone<CR>the way Kirara could thanks to the voice.

records.jp: きららは、みんなと何を話せばいいのか<CR>分からない
records.en_original: I don't know what to say when I talk with everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know what to say when I talk with everyone.
records.en: Kirara doesn't know<CR>what to talk about with everyone.

records.jp: 普通に話せばいいと思うけど……<CR>きららは、それが普通じゃなかったってことか
records.en_original: I would say just be yourself, but...I guess you don't know how to.
records.en_auxiliary: I would say just be yourself, but...I guess you don't know how to.
records.en: I would say just talk normally...<CR>but I guess that was never normal for you, Kirara.

records.jp: そう。今までは、声がすべて教えてくれた
records.en_original: Yes. Up until now the voice told me everything.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Up until now the voice told me everything.
records.en: Correct. Until now, the voice told Kirara everything.

records.jp: きららの質問に、声が答えてくれていたから……<CR>今は、分からないことばかりなのだ
records.en_original: Everything I asked, it answered. I find myself lost without it.
records.en_auxiliary: Everything I asked, it answered. I find myself lost without it.
records.en: The voice always answered Kirara's questions...<CR>Now there are so many things Kirara doesn't understand.

records.jp: みんなとも、話してみたりしたの？
records.en_original: Have you talked with everyone yet?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you talked with everyone yet?
records.en: Have you tried talking with everyone?

records.jp: ……した。<CR>でも、上手くいかなかった……
records.en_original: Yes... It...did not go well.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... It...did not go well.
records.en: ...Kirara did.<CR>But it didn't go well...

records.jp: みんな、ちゃんと答えてくれるけど<CR>あまり会話が嚙み合ってない気がするのだ
records.en_original: Everyone answered the questions I asked, but I feel as though the conversation did not flow well.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone answered the questions I asked, but I feel as though the conversation did not flow well.
records.en: Everyone answers Kirara properly,<CR>but the conversations never seem to quite connect.

records.jp: あれはきっと、きららに話を<CR>合わせてくれているんだと思う……
records.en_original: I'm sure they were trying their best to follow along with me...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure they were trying their best to follow along with me...
records.en: Kirara thinks they are surely<CR>adjusting the conversation to accommodate Kirara...

records.jp: （あー、なんとなく想像できるなあ）
records.en_original: (Ahhh, I think I can imagine that happening.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ahhh, I think I can imagine that happening.)
records.en: (Ahh, I can kind of imagine that.)

records.jp: ……愛央はすごい
records.en_original: You are quite amazing, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You are quite amazing, Ao.
records.en: ...Ao is amazing.

records.jp: え、何が？
records.en_original: Huh? How so?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? How so?
records.en: Huh? In what way?

records.jp: ずっとみんなの中心にいる。<CR>みんなが、愛央のところに集まってくる
records.en_original: You're always at the center of everything. Everyone gathers around you.
records.en_auxiliary: You're always at the center of everything. Everyone gathers around you.
records.en: Ao is always at the center of everyone.<CR>Everyone gathers around Ao.

records.jp: いやいや、私は普通だよ！<CR>てか、すごいのはみんなの方だし！
records.en_original: Aw, come on, I'm just normal! All of them are the amazing ones!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, come on, I'm just normal! All of them are the amazing ones!
records.en: No, no, I'm normal!<CR>Besides, everyone else is the amazing one!

records.jp: …………。<CR>てかさ、私だってきららがうらやましいよ？
records.en_original: If anything, I'm actually jealous of you, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: If anything, I'm actually jealous of you, Kirara.
records.en: ............<CR>Besides, I am jealous of you too, Kirara.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: きららと話してると、<CR>めちゃくちゃ知識豊富だなーと思って
records.en_original: Just talking with you I can tell how smart you are.
records.en_auxiliary: Just talking with you I can tell how smart you are.
records.en: Talking with you,<CR>I'm always amazed by how much you know.

records.jp: それってさ、他の誰とでも<CR>共通の話題があるってことじゃないの？
records.en_original: You should have plenty to talk about with other people.
records.en_auxiliary: You should have plenty to talk about with other people.
records.en: Doesn't that mean you can find<CR>something in common to discuss with anybody?

records.jp: その知識は、神様のものじゃなくて<CR>きららのものでしょ？
records.en_original: The Divine didn't make you smart, that's just you.
records.en_auxiliary: The Divine didn't make you smart, that's just you.
records.en: That knowledge isn't the Divine's.<CR>It's yours, right, Kirara?

records.jp: きららの力……
records.en_original: My own power...
records.en_auxiliary: My own power...
records.en: Kirara's own power...

records.jp: そう。だから、そんなに気にしなくて<CR>いいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Exactly! I don't think you have to worry so much about it.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! I don't think you have to worry so much about it.
records.en: Exactly. So maybe you don't need<CR>to worry about it so much?

records.jp: 分かった……また、みんなと話してみる
records.en_original: Okay. I'll try speaking with everyone again.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. I'll try speaking with everyone again.
records.en: Understood... Kirara will try talking with everyone again.

records.jp: うん！　きららならきっとできるよ！
records.en_original: Good! I believe in you!
records.en_auxiliary: Good! I believe in you!
records.en: Yeah! I know you can do it, Kirara!
